candidate_sentence_map.S1: Telia Lietuva, AB reported strong first-half 2026 financial results, with consolidated revenue reaching EUR 259.1 million, up 7.2 percent from EUR 241.7 million in the prior year.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Adjusted EBITDA increased 10.2 percent to EUR 106.9 million, expanding the adjusted EBITDA margin to 41.3 percent from 40.1 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Operating profit before income tax rose 16.6 percent to EUR 61.3 million, while net profit totaled EUR 51.3 million, a 14.7 percent increase.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: The company generated EUR 103.1 million in operating cash flow, a 15.0 percent improvement year-on-year, yielding free cash flow of EUR 64.1 million, up 12.5 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Capital expenditures surged 57.9 percent to EUR 37.5 million, heavily weighted toward EUR 9.7 million in 5G spectrum licenses.
candidate_sentence_map.S6: Despite higher capex, the balance sheet shifted to a net cash position of negative EUR 4.3 million, contrasting with a EUR 27.5 million net debt balance at the end of June 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S7: Revenue growth was broad-based, driven by an 8.3 percent rise in mobile service revenue, a 5.3 percent increase in fixed services, and a 9.6 percent jump in equipment sales.
candidate_sentence_map.S8: Lithuanian mobile data traffic continues to grow at approximately 25 percent annually, creating immediate capacity requirements that justified the company acquiring two 1,500 MHz frequency blocks for nearly EUR 8 million and extending 2,100 MHz rights for EUR 2 million.
candidate_sentence_map.S9: These licenses will enable enhanced 5G network capabilities and faster data transmission in underserved areas.
candidate_sentence_map.S10: Management also committed to investing EUR 7.1 million during 2026 to build 50 new base stations and modernize existing sites.
candidate_sentence_map.S11: Furthermore, construction began on a new Tier III data center near Vilnius, with a planned EUR 26 million investment targeting completion by mid-2027.
candidate_sentence_map.S12: Operating expenses excluding non-recurring items grew 10.2 percent, outpacing revenue in certain categories.
candidate_sentence_map.S13: Higher cost of goods reflected increased equipment sales volume alongside elevated interconnection and roaming costs.
candidate_sentence_map.S14: Employee-related expenses included EUR 1.4 million in non-recurring redundancy payments related to the Digital and Technology unit restructuring.
candidate_sentence_map.S15: Energy costs rose 14.3 percent, and external IT service expenses increased 18.4 percent.
candidate_sentence_map.S16: The company successfully maintained margin expansion through operational efficiency.
candidate_sentence_map.S17: Robust cash generation supported a record dividend payout of EUR 81.6 million, representing EUR 0.14 per share for 2025.
candidate_sentence_map.S18: Governance updates included Andreas Ekström joining the Board and Vaidas Dominauskas assuming leadership of the Enterprise unit, supporting ongoing strategic infrastructure and organizational development.
